arguments.sql:
WITH session_bounds AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_stamp, MAX(stamp) AS last_stamp
    FROM activity_log
    WHERE action = 'view'
    GROUP BY session
),
endpoint_ties AS (
    SELECT log.session, log.stamp
    FROM activity_log AS log
    JOIN session_bounds AS bounds
      ON log.session = bounds.session
     AND log.stamp IN (bounds.first_stamp, bounds.last_stamp)
    WHERE log.action = 'view'
    GROUP BY log.session, log.stamp
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT log.path) > 1
)
SELECT action,
       COUNT(*) AS row_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT path) AS path_count,
       SUM(path IS NULL OR path = '') AS missing_paths,
       SUM(session IS NULL OR session = '') AS missing_sessions,
       SUM(stamp IS NULL OR datetime(stamp) IS NULL OR stamp <> datetime(stamp)) AS noncanonical_stamps,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM endpoint_ties) AS tied_endpoint_count
FROM activity_log
GROUP BY action
ORDER BY action

WITH page_bounds AS (
    SELECT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_stamp, MAX(stamp) AS last_stamp
    FROM activity_log
    WHERE path IS NOT NULL AND path <> ''
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT quote(log.path) AS stored_path,
       COUNT(*) AS row_count,
       SUM(log.stamp IN (bounds.first_stamp, bounds.last_stamp)) AS endpoint_rows
FROM activity_log AS log
LEFT JOIN page_bounds AS bounds ON log.session = bounds.session
GROUP BY log.path
ORDER BY log.path

WITH session_bounds AS (
    SELECT session,
           MIN(stamp) AS first_stamp,
           MAX(stamp) AS last_stamp,
           MIN(CASE WHEN path <> '' THEN stamp END) AS first_known_path_stamp,
           MAX(CASE WHEN path <> '' THEN stamp END) AS last_known_path_stamp
    FROM activity_log
    GROUP BY session
)
SELECT log."option", log.search_type,
       COUNT(*) AS rows_with_empty_path,
       SUM(log.stamp = bounds.first_stamp) AS at_first_timestamp,
       SUM(log.stamp = bounds.last_stamp) AS at_last_timestamp,
       SUM(bounds.first_stamp <> bounds.first_known_path_stamp) AS changed_first_timestamp,
       SUM(bounds.last_stamp <> bounds.last_known_path_stamp) AS changed_last_timestamp
FROM activity_log AS log
JOIN session_bounds AS bounds ON log.session = bounds.session
WHERE log.path = ''
GROUP BY log."option", log.search_type

WITH page_visits AS (
    SELECT session,
           path,
           stamp,
           MIN(stamp) OVER (PARTITION BY session) AS first_stamp,
           MAX(stamp) OVER (PARTITION BY session) AS last_stamp
    FROM main.activity_log
    WHERE action = 'view'
)
SELECT path,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
           WHEN stamp = first_stamp OR stamp = last_stamp THEN session
       END) AS session_count
FROM page_visits
WHERE path IS NOT NULL AND path <> ''
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY path
LIMIT -1
